## 2025-05-15 - [API DX] Standardizing [ BRACKET ] Labeling in Documentation
**Learning:** UX consistency should extend beyond the graphical UI to technical interfaces like Swagger/Redoc. Using the `[ BRACKET ]` naming convention in the FastAPI title and descriptions reinforces the SATTVA "Bloomberg Terminal" aesthetic for developers and API consumers.
**Action:** Always wrap top-level API components and capability headers in `[ BRACKETS ]` and use `Literal` types to provide intuitive dropdowns in auto-generated documentation.
